observer.frame: e0=N^-1 partial_t; e1=N^-1 partial_x; e2=r^-1 partial_theta; e3=(r sin(theta))^-1 partial_phi
observer.normal_covariant_tidal_tensor: diag(-A, B00, B00); components R_0i0j in signature +---
observer.normal_worldline_acceleration: a^hat1=N_x/N^2; fixed x normals are generally accelerated
observer.freefall_interpretation: The tidal tensor gives instantaneous geodesic deviation for freely falling particles momentarily comoving with the normal. Fixed-x worldlines require acceleration; their relative acceleration also includes the acceleration field.

riemann_convention: R^a_bcd = d_c Gamma^a_db - d_d Gamma^a_cb + Gamma^a_ce Gamma^e_db - Gamma^a_de Gamma^e_cb; Ricci_bd = R^a_bad; signature (+---)

formulas.acceleration: Q_t = P[Q p_chi / (2 F_chi)], Q_tt = P[(Q_t p_chi + Q p_chi_t)/(2 F_chi)], r_t = P[pi/(2 Z)], pi = p_r - F_r p_chi/F_chi, F_r = -8 pi A r, r_tt = P[d/dt(pi)/(2 Z)] along the same projected rate

finite_window.statement: The saved window reaches coordinate time 3 with a positive chart and finite tidal components. This finite window is the measured domain.
